keyword: order diesel 120 twin engine concrete pump

title.en: “Pump Performance Curve” leaves 0.6 m³, also printed on LZ-80 on the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump row
title.zh: 「泵性能曲线」不改柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机这一行里的「6 cm 及以下。」

description.en: Diesel 120 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. 0.6 m³, also printed on LZ-80 Diesel 40 prints one Kawasaki 112
description.zh: 柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机见 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。6 cm 及以下。是 100 m³/h。

h1.en: Pump Performance Curve does not retitle the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「泵性能曲线」并不改写柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 120 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. 0.6 m³, also printed on LZ-80. Diesel 40 prints one Kawasaki 112. Do not shorten Diesel 120 to that single line. 40 MPa appears on both pages and does not merge them. Use it on the transport note with 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. An order that says 120 m³/h has replaced the output cell. An order that says 145 kW once has dropped a printed unit. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m on a 110 kW motor. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 120 as engine power 290 kW (two units of 145 kW), theoretical output 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, 150 m / 500 m, Kawasaki 112 (two units), aggregate 6 cm and below, 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg. The section title “The System Curve” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。6 cm 及以下。是 100 m³/h。不要把柴油120缩成那一行。柴油40印一台川崎 112。0.6 m³，LZ-80 也印了这个数字。两页都出现 40 MPa，这并不能把它们合并。写成 120 m³/h 的订单替换了输送量格。只写一次 145 kW 的订单丢掉了印出的一台。把它和 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm 一起写进运输说明。电动80在 110 kW 电机上印 60 m³/h 和 900 m / 300 m。河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油120印成发动机功率 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、理论输送量 100 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.6 m³、150 m / 500 m、川崎 112（两台）、骨料 6 cm 及以下、7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm、8000 kg。节标题「系统曲线」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: For Diesel 120 Concrete Pump, the heading “The System Curve” does not replace a cell. 0.6 m³, also printed on LZ-80. Use it on the transport note with 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 120 as engine power 290 kW (two units of 145 kW), theoretical output 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, 150 m / 500 m, Kawasaki 112 (two units), aggregate 6 cm and below, 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg.
body.zh: 对柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机而言，标题「系统曲线」并不替换任何格子。0.6 m³，LZ-80 也印了这个数字。把它和 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm 一起写进运输说明。河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油120印成发动机功率 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、理论输送量 100 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.6 m³、150 m / 500 m、川崎 112（两台）、骨料 6 cm 及以下、7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm、8000 kg。

body.en: Diesel 120 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Pump Performance Curve”. Diesel 40 prints one Kawasaki 112. An order that says 120 m³/h has replaced the output cell.
body.zh: 柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机不因标题「泵性能曲线」而改动。柴油40印一台川崎 112。写成 120 m³/h 的订单替换了输送量格。6 cm 及以下。

body.en: This section is titled “Selection of Pump”. Diesel 120 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Do not shorten Diesel 120 to that single line. An order that says 145 kW once has dropped a printed unit.
body.zh: 本节标题是「泵的选型」。柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机下面这些格子仍是印出来的。不要把柴油120缩成那一行。只写一次 145 kW 的订单丢掉了印出的一台。是 100 m³/h。

body.en: Under “Best Efficiency Point - BEP”, Diesel 120 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. 40 MPa appears on both pages and does not merge them. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m on a 110 kW motor. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pump-system-curves-d_635.html.
body.zh: 在「最佳效率点 - BEP」下，柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机这一节只放已印出的格子。两页都出现 40 MPa，这并不能把它们合并。电动80在 110 kW 电机上印 60 m³/h 和 900 m / 300 m。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pump-system-curves-d_635.html。

question.en: Does “The System Curve” replace 0.6 m³, also printed on LZ-80?
question.zh: 「系统曲线」会替换「6 cm 及以下。」吗？

answer.en: No. 0.6 m³, also printed on LZ-80 remains the printed wording for Diesel 120 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。6 cm 及以下。仍是柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Diesel 40 prints one Kawasaki 112 belong on the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机这一行里，「是 100 m³/h。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Pump Performance Curve” add to Diesel 120 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「泵性能曲线」给柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pump-system-curves-d_635.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pump-system-curves-d_635.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside 0.6 m³, also printed on LZ-80?
question.zh: 「6 cm 及以下。」旁边印了标价吗？
